name: session-pings
description: Mac notifications titled with the session name, saying what Claude needs from you: done, a question, or a permission. Works out of the box; install terminal-notifier (brew install terminal-notifier) to make notifications clickable, which brings you back to the app you were using.

remindAfterMinutes.title: Remind after (minutes)
remindAfterMinutes.description: Notify once more if a question or permission is still unanswered after this many minutes. 0 turns reminders off.

aiSummaries.title: AI task names and summaries
aiSummaries.description: Use Haiku (on your Claude Code login) to name the task in a few words and summarize the result in one line. Off: uses the first words of your message and of Claude's reply.

doneSound.title: Sound when Claude is done
doneSound.description: A macOS sound name (Glass, Ping, Pop, Hero, ...).

attentionSound.title: Sound when Claude needs you
attentionSound.description: A macOS sound name for questions, permissions and reminders.
